NewsBlur is free to use at newsblur.com (up to 64 sites) with premium plans available, or you can self-host your own instance using this repository.
To customize your NewsBlur installation, create `newsblur_web/local_settings.py` to override settings from `docker_local_settings.py`.
See the full list in `docker_local_settings.py` and `settings.py`.

NewsBlur includes an MCP server that lets AI agents (Claude Desktop, Claude Code, Cursor, or any MCP-compatible client) interact with your feeds, stories, and classifiers. Premium subscription required.
|`newsblur_list_feeds`|All subscribed feeds with folders and unread counts|
|`newsblur_get_stories`|Load stories from feeds, folders, or all subscriptions|
|`newsblur_mark_stories_read`|Mark stories read by hash, feed, or folder|
|`newsblur_save_story`|Save a story with tags, notes, and highlights|
|`newsblur_train_classifier`|Train like/dislike on title, author, tag, or feed|

Any function in PostgreSQL can be specified by Oid or by name or by signature. When
you know oid or complete function's signature, you can use a regprocedure type parameter
like `'fx()'::regprocedure` or `16799::regprocedure`. Possible alternative is using
a name only, when function's name is unique - like `'fx'`. When the name is not unique
or the function doesn't exists it raises a error.

The column list supports only a column name and a type (with optional type modifiers and array dimensions) - column constraints (`PRIMARY KEY`, `NOT NULL`, `DEFAULT`, `CHECK`) and `COLLATE` clauses are not supported here.
